Anything observed but unrecorded is a recovery hole; anything recorded but never observed is a stale entry that will send the next responder somewhere nothing happened. Side effects produced by a child process are either captured or declared an uncovered region.
REL-0022.title: Rollback coverage measured by instrumenting a real install, not by reading the manifest
